strategy.summary: TODO-7 adds completing, filtering and clearing todos to the static todo app (public/app.js, state held in memory in the page). The tests must prove, in a real browser against the app served by server.js, that ticking/unticking a todo toggles its strike-through and the "items left" count, that All/Active/Completed show the right todos and mark the selected filter pressed, and that "Clear completed" shows only while a todo is completed and removes every completed todo (and only those).
inScope: Completing and uncompleting a todo via its checkbox (strike-through and items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their aria-pressed state
Clear completed visibility and removal of completed todos
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js; used only as setup)
Persistence across reloads — the app keeps todos in memory only and the ticket does not ask for it
assumptions: The real first-party server (server.js, started by Playwright's existing webServer config on port 4173) runs for real; nothing is faked. The app has no backend API or access control, so no auth cases apply.
Todos live in page memory, so each test gets a fresh page and creates its own todos through the UI; tests share no state.
'Struck through' is asserted as the user-visible computed style text-decoration-line: line-through on the todo's text (from styles.css li.completed span), not the CSS class.
The todo's checkbox is reached by role checkbox with the todo title as its accessible name (the label wraps the checkbox and title).
openQuestions: playwright.config.js serves on 4173, the same port as `npm start`, with reuseExistingServer outside CI, so a developer's running server could be reused locally; left unchanged since run_tests targets BASE_URL=http://localhost:4173.

risks.description: Count text or strike-through not updated on toggle (render not called / wrong count)
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2 assert exact count text and computed style before and after each toggle

risks.description: Filter shows wrong items or pressed state out of sync
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert exact list contents and aria-pressed of all three buttons per filter

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos too or stays visible
risks.mitigation: TC6 checks hidden when nothing completed; TC7 checks only completed are removed and button hides

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: its text is struck through and the 'items left' count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
The Active filter shows only todos that aren't completed, Completed only those that are, All shows every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
'Clear completed' appears only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
steps: Assert '2 items left' and 'Buy milk' text not struck through
testCases.expected: Checkbox checked; 'Buy milk' text has text-decoration-line line-through; 'Walk dog' not struck through; count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
steps: Tick 'Buy milk' and assert '1 item left'
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked; 'Buy milk' text-decoration-line is none; count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed aria-pressed=false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed aria-pressed=true, All and Active false

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
steps: Click Completed and assert one item
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All aria-pressed=true, Active and Completed false

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Add 'Buy milk' and assert it is listed
Tick 'Buy milk' and assert Clear completed visible
testCases.expected: Clear completed is hidden before ticking, visible while ticked, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: Refusal side of AC3: the action isn't offered without completed todos

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog']; count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Removes all completed (more than one) and only those

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). Chromium installed. No env vars, seeds or backend.
